design.purpose: A flat six-pointed paper decoration for a window or card, made by one person.

steps.c: Place the 20 cm square sheet flat.
Fold top-right corner onto bottom-left corner.
Fold top-left corner onto bottom-right corner.
Fold top-right edge through top at 30°.
Fold top-left edge through top at 30°.
Cut straight across the wedge wide end.
Cut a triangular notch in left edge.
Cut a triangular notch in right edge.
Cut a small notch across pointed tip.
Open sheet flat to reveal snowflake.
